Cobra Can: Cortech Cobra Can Food Grade and General Use Trash Receptacle
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-cobra-can-food-grade-general-use-trash-receptacle
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/facilities-maintenance/cobra-can/
Spec sheet: Cobra Can Food Grade and General Use
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Cobra Can Food Grade and General Use Trash Receptacle
Current H1: Cortech Cobra Can Food Grade Trash Receptacle - General Use
Subtitle: Virtually Unbreakable Molded Trash Can for Kitchens and General Use, in Nine Sizes from 20 to 55 Gallons
Current subtitle: Cortech USA Cobra Trash Cans - Trash Receptacle Suitable For Food Service or General Use
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Cobra Can Food Grade and General Use Trash Receptacle is a virtually unbreakable trash can for kitchens, dining halls, and general use in correctional and other high-abuse facilities. It comes in nine sizes from 20 to 55 gallons.
The can is rotationally molded from structural polyethylene for strength with some flexibility. Molded-in handles run around the entire can and its underside for easier lifting, and molded-in floor glides reduce floor scratching when the can is dragged.
Material: Rotationally molded structural polyethylene; 0.22” nominal wall thickness
Sizes: 20, 22, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, or 55 gallons
Handles: 360° molded-in continuous handles around the entire can perimeter and underside
Floor Glides: Molded-in floor glides reduce floor scratching when the can is dragged
Durability: Virtually unbreakable
Colors: Blue, Green, Red, White, Yellow, or Black (custom colors available on request)
Dolly: Cobra Can dolly sold separately (DCC for 20 to 30 gallon cans, DCCL for 35 to 55 gallon cans)
Warranty: 10-year factory warranty
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards

Installation and Options
No assembly is required.
[H2] Applications
The food grade and general use Cobra Can suits kitchens and other areas that need a trash can that will not break.
Typical applications include:
Housing units, dayrooms, and common areas in correctional facilities and jails
Kitchens, dining halls, and food service areas
Behavioral healthcare facilities and other high-abuse settings
Explore Anchortex's Prison Janitorial and Sanitation Supplies and Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collections for more trash receptacles and sanitation supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Facilities Maintenance
Cortech facilities maintenance products are molded to stand up to hard daily use in correctional facilities, behavioral healthcare facilities, and other high-abuse settings.
Cortech facilities maintenance includes:
Trash Receptacles: Cobra Cans in 20 to 55 gallon sizes, in flame retardant or food grade and general use material, and Cobra Mini Cans in 10 and 14 quart sizes
Can Dollies: Cobra Can dollies in two sizes
Carts: Kangaroo Carts and lids for laundry, trash, and material handling
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (58 characters): Cortech Cobra Can Food Grade Trash Receptacle at Anchortex
Meta description (150 characters): Shop the Cortech Cobra Can. A virtually unbreakable molded trash can for kitchens and general use, in nine sizes from 20 to 55 gallons and six colors.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Facilities Maintenance" is a new section for the Cobra Can, Cobra Mini Can, can dolly, and Kangaroo Cart pages. It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: Cortech calls it the Cobra Can Food Grade and General Use Waste Container. I used "Food Grade and General Use Trash Receptacle." There are nine model numbers, so I left them out of the H1.
Colors: your variants are all Blue (620B). The Cortech spec sheet also lists Green (720G), Red (584R), White (2W), Yellow (451Y), and Black (116B) in all nine sizes. I listed the colors but kept only your Blue variants in Available Models. Would you like the other colors added as variants?
Weight and size: your variants are set to 255 lbs, which looks like a placeholder. The Cortech spec sheet says "See Chart" for the weight but has no chart, and it gives no dimensions, so I left both out. Can you get the weights from Cortech?
Warranty: your current page does not list a warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says 10-year factory warranty, so I added it.
I left out "Resistant to stains," since the Cortech spec sheet does not say this.
Collection links: the can is in your Prison Janitorial and Sanitation Supplies and Kitchen and Food Service collections, so I linked those two.
Product images: the page has one image (55 gallon, Blue). I did not find other photos of this version on the Cortech website.
